title: Telemessage
text: You grunt and twist the valve. A pipe slides into position, and you hear a few tones of music. Presumably, navigation is now online, allowing you to make jumps to other planes of Oblivion. You also suddenly notice a cube near the valve, and pick it up.

title: repair2
text: You bang and weld and forge for hours, slowly plugging up the holes and kinks that you see around the machine. Though the process is slow, it pays off, and soon after you are finished the weapon hums to life. You suddenly feel watched, as if the ship is awaiting your orders to fire this cannon or something. Perhaps you can use magic, or something similar, to call an orbital strike from it.

title: repair1
text: It may have been time or overuse, but this machine has seen better days. Melted, blown up, various pipes and mechanisms are in an advanced state of disrepair. Despite this however, the damage is repairable, although extensive. You think with about say, 25 Dwarven metal ingots, you could patch up the various pieces of this cannon.

title: notEnough
text: You suspect that you can't deposit Aetherium pieces you don't have. You should go find the rest.

title: fullFuel
text: One by one, you deposit the Aetherium pieces into the container, though to your disappointment there is limited fanfare when the final pieces drops in. Still, the engine roars to life, and you feel like you've accomplished something, which you have.

title: questStart
text: The wind picks up, and while irrelevant dust blows around you, a scrap of paper flies towards you, eventually hitting you in the face in a manner most assuredly comical. While such encounters might be dismissed by others as chance, your adventures have left you knowing that such events are often the result of things beyond your comprehension, though many things are beyond your comprehension, such as multiplication, not going to the bathroom outside of your armor, and words longer than four letters. Nevertheless, you pocket the scrap, making a mental note to find someone to read it aloud to you later.

title: lootalert
text: Before the Centurion falls into the lava, you dive recklessly forward, grabbing it. While the metal is white-hot, your limited intelligence allows you to ignore it. You heave and pull and manage to pluck the Aetherium fuel shard off of it, before letting it fall back into the lava.
